entry.title: MySQL Exploitation
entry.content:
Secure File Privileges

secure_file_priv in MySQL controls where you can read/write files.

  • Only users with the FILE privilege can use LOAD DATA, SELECT INTO OUTFILE, or LOAD_FILE().

  • Settings: of Secure File Privileges

    • Empty: No restriction (not secure).

    • Directory path: Can only read/write in that folder.

    • NULL: File operations are disabled.

Example :

In the following example, the secure_file_priv variable is empty, which means MySQL can read and write files from any directory that the MySQL service account has permission to access.
